scope: Fixed full-mainboard v3 event set, signal years 2020-2024, no leader grouping or new selection
day_definition: D0 is the first official calendar session after signal_date, D+k is calendar ordinal D0+k; never next observed tradable bar
entry: Only valid raw open on D0 gives an anchor; six suspended D0 events retained without anchor at every horizon, never delayed
observation_validity: Suspension/tradestatus!=1 or zero/unknown volume or invalid open/high/close is not an observed high/close; no forward fill. Exact field-specific validity will be explicit in common engine contract.

metrics.mean_daily_high_return: Equal-event arithmetic mean of valid normalized day-high returns at each horizon; not a sale at the high
metrics.mean_event_cumulative_high_return: Per event, maximum known traded high from D0 through horizon; confirmed suspension/zero-volume contributes no new traded high but preserves prior known max. An unknown/missing high or unexplained adjustment prefix blocks primary cumulative high thereafter; then equal-event mean of valid event maxima.
metrics.mean_close_return: Equal-event arithmetic mean of valid normalized close returns at each horizon
metrics.close_positive_win_rate: Strictly return>0 count / valid close-return count; zeros are not wins
metrics.price_normalization: Shared frozen engine: qfq day high/entry qfq open-1 and qfq day close/entry qfq open-1. This is an adjusted-price path, not net economic/account return. Raw ratios are diagnostics only. No cash dividends, tax/fee, share-account or payment accounting.

prefix_unknown: Only unknown/missing high or unexplained adjustment creates unknown prefix. Confirmed suspension/zero-volume creates no traded high, preserves known prior cumulative max, and flags prefix_has_suspension=true/all_sessions_traded=false.
right_censoring: Keep all 3805 event ids at every one of 21 horizons, mark beyond frozen calendar as censored; never delete an entire event because D+20 unavailable; report horizon-specific valid and invalid denominators per metric
denominators: At each horizon: full cohort N=3805, anchor-valid N, known day high N, complete-prefix high N, known close N, close-positive N, and disjoint reason counts. N differs by metric and horizon; rates always identify denominator.
T_plus_1: D0 close/high are descriptive path marks, not sellable outcomes; D0 can_sell=false; no implication that any later observed high is an executable fill
company_action_gate: Targeted successful issuer-year responses only, not exhaustive. Missing response is coverage limitation, not assumed empty and not blanket block. Unverified declared CROSS-entry action or fixed-tolerance unexplained raw/qfq discrepancy blocks affected primary labels. Entry-day action does not count as cross-entry.
shared_engine_gate: Read only exact authorized source file after hash verification; copy into this output directory with source hash. Do not traverse source directory or read direction2 results.
independent_checks: Pure synthetic tests of daily vs per-event cumulative means
Suspended observation leaves daily/close missing and permanently blocks cumulative prefix
Gross no-action raw price arithmetic independently checked for real sample after engine whitelist
Corporate-action sample arithmetic checked only after shared convention/evidence available
outputs: Frozen copied common engine after authorization
All-event long horizon table and summary by D0..D20
Independent verification and source/input access audit
